Alpha Industries Announces First Quarter 2025 Results

Alpha Industries (NYSE: AAA) today reported financial results for its first fiscal quarter ended March 29, 2025.

GAAP diluted earnings per share were $0.55, compared with $0.48 in the prior year quarter.

Revenue was $1.20 billion, up 8% from the prior year quarter.

Looking ahead, the company expects second quarter revenue growth of 6% to 8%.
